Brand details · v1.0
UNBC's Independent Student Newspaper

Forest on newsprint, off the press.

The full reference for Over the Edge's "Forest press" identity: the paper's own lettering, one green on one paper, Source Serif headlines, Anton on the front page, and the printed issue's dashed index. Everything here is drawn from one brand.json.

v1.0overtheedge.unbc.caGenerated by brandkit
Positioning and voice

Students talking to students.

Curious, warm and a little wry. Plain in the news; playful in features, when the story earns it.

Breaking news, vibrant clubs, can’t-miss events, and a shared university calendar.
The paper's own line, from its homepage
  • HeadlinesTitle Case, as the site and the covers set them: “Bears Don’t Really Hibernate… Or Do They?”, “Green So Far”.
  • First personWelcome in features and columns. Never in news.
  • Exclamation marksFeatures and event promotion only.
  • DatesMonth spelled out: “[Mon] [D], [YYYY]” on screen, “[MONTH] [D]TH” on covers. Never all numbers, which readers split on.
  • EmojiNone in headlines, navigation or interface.
Logo

The paper’s own lettering.

Drawn path for path from the SVG the site serves. One colour at a time: Forest or Ink on light grounds, White or Lichen on Forest, Pine or Moss.

  • Clear spaceHalf the height of the O on every side.
  • NeverRedraw it, reset it in a font, outline it, stretch it, add effects, or set it in two colours other than the site's original (kept in logos/source/).
Colour

One green, one paper, one ink.

From the site's theme and the April 2025 cover. Proof red is an editor's mark: Breaking and Correction only.

  • Forest#155329The brand. The logo, links, primary buttons, page numbers, masthead blocks.
  • Pine#0C3B1CDeep ground for covers and slides; pressed buttons.
  • Newsprint#F5F1E6The page. Every surface starts here.
  • Ink#262626Headlines and body text; the logo in one colour on light grounds.
  • Lichen#E3EFCFLogo and text on forest; light panels.
  • Sage#6AA380Print boxes and large figures on pine or forest, 24 px and up.
  • Moss#466855Photo wells and info boxes on covers, with white text.
  • Kraft#D4C8AARules and placeholders only. Not a text colour.
  • Pulp#DBD0BAHairlines and quiet patterns only. Not a text colour.
  • Bark#7D6B56Metadata, labels and dashed index rules.
  • Proof#B54A35Breaking and Correction, and nothing else.
  • White#FFFFFFCards, paper stock, and text on forest, pine, moss and proof.

Typography

Five voices, five jobs.

Helvetica Neue and Salted are supplied original faces. Anton remains the substitute for Decalotype Black; keep the supplied font notices.

Print devices and templates

Borrowed from the front page.

The dashed index, two-digit page numbers in Anton, the forest masthead and date box, and a white keyline inside a forest photo frame. Corners are square.

Motion

Off the press, one word at a time.

The full library, with replay, is motion/index.html in the kit and brandkit's Motion tab.

  • PressLogo

    OVER, THE and EDGE print in one at a time, dropping a few pixels into place; then UNBC’S STUDENT NEWSPAPER rises under them.

  • StackLogo

    The stacked logo, each line rising out of its own mask, as on the October 2025 cover.

  • InkLogo

    The logo is uncovered left to right, the way a roller lays ink on a plate.

  • Rolling rulesLoading

    The issue index’s dashed rules roll past, one line after another.

  • Page countLoading

    Anton page numbers turn over: 03, 05, 10, as in the index.

  • O fillLoading

    The O fills with forest from the foot up, holds, and empties. The O only; it stops when loading ends.

  • Paper airplaneLoading

    A paper airplane, like the one drawn on the October 2025 cover, glides along a dashed line.

  • HeadlineInterface

    Each line of a Source Serif headline rises out of its own mask.

  • Card pickInterface

    A story card lifts 3 px, shifts 1 px and turns 0.4°, like a clipping picked up off the desk, then settles.

  • IndexInterface

    Each dashed rule draws across, then its page number and headline come in.

  • ChipInterface

    A filter chip presses in to 96%, and its border and label turn forest.

  • Turn pageInterface

    The next page slides over from the right edge, square-cornered, like turning a broadsheet.

  • SkeletonInterface

    Placeholder lines in Pulp with a Newsprint highlight passing along them.

Where it can go next

Proposals, not rules.

Ideas the system makes easy. None of them is decided.

  • A page grid for printSet the inside pages on the same dashed rules and Anton folios as the cover.
  • The site, refreshedThe homepage in site/ shows the identity on the web: masthead, latest issue, top stories, calendar.
  • Section frontsAnton section names over a forest band, one per section of the paper.
